verdict: Yes, as a purpose-led brand. Tickle Your Art from Pune pitched art by artists with Down syndrome on Shark Tank India Season 4 and got a deal. Buyers and companies want to support inclusive employment, but the art itself must be good enough to buy for its own sake.
angle: Prints, stationery, apparel and decor featuring work by neurodivergent artists sell to individuals and to companies for gifting. Artists should earn royalties and be credited. Corporate gifting and CSR partnerships are strong channels.
